data_fields.name: finish_hp_limit_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 (percent of max HP; bonus stored x10)

best_idea: A finisher that replaces a hit's damage with a flat amount only when the target is under an HP ratio, under a level cap, and on a per-mille roll, so the rule is data and the server rolls it.
decision_why: Take the gate order (HP threshold, level cap, chance roll, then a flat number) as the Frankendom finisher rule; drop the crit-roll coupling and the client exemption until the Pit's rules say otherwise, and let the server roll it.
acceptance: A rival below 10% of max HP takes a finishing blow on a server-rolled hit, a rival at 11% never does, and a player-controlled target is never finished; a server test with a fixed roll sequence asserts the fire condition exactly.
